script:
extends SceneTree
var comparisons = []
func compare(a,b):
    comparisons.append(a)
    comparisons.append(b)
    return null
func _init():
    var items = range(8)
    items.sort_custom(self,"compare")
    var file = File.new()
    file.open("res://result.json",File.WRITE)
    file.store_string(JSON.print({"order":items,"comparisons":comparisons}))
    file.close()
    quit()
